restrictions: Target the exact fixed-IV sha256-r31-prefix-v1 hash of complete 40-byte messages, with FIPS one-block padding, original schedule/constants, round indices 0 through 30, full feed-forward and all 256 digest bits.

Draw exactly q=255*2^120 independent uniform 40-byte messages from two fresh independent 256-bit words per sample; store full digests and messages and apply two stable 128-bit radix counting-sort passes.

Charge q sampled target compressions plus at most two verification compressions, all failed samples, all bucket initialization/prefix work, all record scans, and at most 128q+32*2^128+2^24 ordinary word operations.

Use a 256-bit word RAM with three two-word q-record arrays and one 2^128-word counter array; peak allocated storage is below 2^136 bytes. No nonuniform advice, differential assumption, witness lookup, or restart is used.
